record.name: Reposition
record.narrative: You execute a tactical reposition, moving an ally to better terrain or safety with practiced efficiency. The power manifests as coordinated movement—a guiding hand, shouted direction, physical assistance—getting allies where they need to be without breaking formation or exposing them to danger.
record.flavor_text: "Move there, now! Trust me!" - Tactical Commander

manifestation.description: directing ally movement with tactical gestures
calculating optimal positioning and safe routes

base_effect.description: You direct an ally to reposition tactically.

mechanics.notes: Ally can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks

class_synergies.narrative: The Scholar's tactical analysis transforms Reposition into perfect battlefield chess. They calculate optimal positioning factoring in cover, firing angles, and threat assessment—moving allies not just to safety but to tactical advantage.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Scholars grant repositioned ally advantage on their next attack from superior positioning.

species_synergies.narrative: Human tactical flexibility makes their repositioning unpredictable and effective. They find movement paths others miss, creating opportunities from chaos, turning desperate retreats into flanking maneuvers through creative thinking.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans allow ally to move full speed instead of half when repositioning.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Rebel Alliance has perfected Reposition through asymmetric warfare. Their tactical retreats aren't defeats but calculated repositioning, drawing enemies into ambushes while appearing to flee—mobility as weapon.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Rebels can reposition 2 allies simultaneously for coordinated movement.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the coordinated movement—a shouted direction, a guiding hand on a shoulder, tactical signals directing allies to cover. Show the repositioning as fluid and purposeful, not panicked retreat but calculated advantage-seeking.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Reposition allows an ally to move half speed without opportunity attacks. Perfect for extracting allies from danger or positioning them for advantage. Uses a superiority die but creates tactical opportunities. The 30-foot range allows battlefield flexibility.
narrative_hooks: Reposition saves an ally from a killing blow at the last moment
The tactical movement reveals the character's military training
Coordinated repositioning creates a devastating tactical advantage

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of a tactical commander repositioning an ally on the battlefield. The leader gestures commandingly, directing coordinated movement to better cover or firing position. The ally moves with purpose, the repositioning clearly calculated for tactical advantage. The scene captures battlefield leadership and strategic movement.
